introHtml: Full color decoration on screen cleaners lets you print logos, photos, or detailed artwork in vibrant detail. Unlike one-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to create a more impactful brand impression. These custom full color screen cleaners are ideal for tech companies, trade show giveaways, or any business wanting to make a colorful statement. Choose from microfiber cloths, spray-and-wipe kits, or all-in-one cleaning solutions.
